text: Your turn. One: which is correct: the team gave in to success, the team gave up their victory happily, the team gave in to win, or the team gave up after one attempt? Two: choose the correct form: take it for granted, take it as granted, take it with granted, or take it by granted? Three: which fits: the manager, blank, to the delays, because the client was a friend? Saw eye to eye, called it a day, turned a blind eye, or called the shots?
